{{Short description|none}} {{Use New Zealand English|date=December 2020}} {{Use dmy dates|date=December 2020}} Eight polling firms have conducted [[opinion polls]] during the term of the [[54th New Zealand Parliament]] (2023–2026) for the [[2026 New Zealand general election]]. The regular polls are the quarterly polls produced by [[Television New Zealand]] (''[[1 News]]'') conducted by [[Verian]] (formerly known as [[Colmar Brunton]] and Kantar Public) and [[Radio New Zealand]] (RNZ) conducted by Reid Research,{{cite web |title=RNZ to run new series of political polls |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/political/545555/rnz-to-run-new-series-of-political-polls |website=[[Radio New Zealand|RNZ]] |access-date=23 March 2025 |date=21 March 2025}} along with monthly polls by [[Roy Morgan]] and by Curia ([[New Zealand Taxpayers' Union|Taxpayers' Union]]). Curia Market Research is no longer a member of the [[Research Association of New Zealand]], following complaints and the resignation from RANZ by its principal, [[David Farrar (blogger)|David Farrar]].{{cite web|url=https://researchassociation.org.nz/Update|title=Update from RANZ Chair on membership resignation by Curia Market Research|publisher=Research Association of New Zealand|first1=Ian|last1=Mills|first2=Geoff|last2=Lowe|date=20 August 2024}} The sample size, margin of error, and confidence interval of each poll varies by organisation and date. The parliament was elected on 14 October 2023, and the election is scheduled to be held on 7 November 2026. ==Party vote== The parties shown in this section are [[New Zealand National Party|National]] (NAT), [[New Zealand Labour Party|Labour]] (LAB), [[Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand|Green]] (GRN), [[ACT New Zealand|ACT]], [[New Zealand First]] (NZF), [[Te Pāti Māori]] (TPM), and the [[Opportunity Party (New Zealand)|Opportunity Party]] (OPP; f.k.a. TOP), Other parties may have also registered in some polls, but are not listed in this section. ===Graphical summary=== [[File:Graph of opinion polls in NZ by party.svg|thumb|center|599x599px|Graph of opinion polls in NZ by party.
